objectives: Qualify the explicit 18-agent active roster without renumbering surviving environments.
Run a complete 18-agent regression after the roster change.
Measure specialist value against a direct Boltzmann SPE baseline using the same structures and settings.
required_evidence: successful Boltzmann SPE execution where the required model is available
correct result parsing and specialist checks
explicit PASS, REVIEW or FAIL status

baseline_comparison.baseline: direct Boltzmann SPE call with already prepared coordinates and settings
baseline_comparison.rule: Only observed, artifact-backed differences may be scored as added value.

cp2k_policy: optional external validation only; excluded from every v2 gate and status
